entries.reason: Diagnose an unexplained CONTROL_REQUEST_FAILED (500) that cancelled a dispatched preparation. Record bounded route and error-code diagnostics, without messages, identifiers, query values or credentials, for control failures the CLI cannot read, and fail closed with CONTROL_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE when control authorization throws. Successful, 4xx and other 500 bodies are unchanged. Three regressions failed before and pass after the repair. Preserve failed public operations and the owner index.
